ValidationRule.description: This is to control the Financial and Non-FInancial Compensation field based on Complaint Remedy selection
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( $Setup.Salesforce_Library_Settings__c.Disable_VRs__c = false, NOT( ISNEW() ), OR( RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Customer_Complaint' , RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Non_Customer_Complaint' ), OR( AND( ISPICKVAL( IDR_Complaint_Remedy__c , '1'), OR( ISBLANK( IDR_Financial_Compensation__c ), (IDR_Financial_Compensation__c <=0), NOT(ISPICKVAL( IDR_Non_Financial_Remedy__c, '')) ) ), AND( ISPICKVAL( IDR_Complaint_Remedy__c , '2'), OR( ISPICKVAL( IDR_Non_Financial_Remedy__c, ''), NOT(ISBLANK(IDR_Financial_Compensation__c)) ) ) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Financial compensation or non-financial remedy must be populated based on the selection in complaint remedy and the other field must be left blank.
